about: Where a project's resource region goes in the FM-1's flash: data its installer writes after the update, released as NAME-res.bin beside the .fwsc. The address is the app's own, compiled into its firmware and in no release file, so it is taken from its source (from: the file and line, at the tag checked). fm1-lab puts the region there for the project's preview (fm1-lab run --resources FILE@ADDR). A project that moves it shows its 'missing' screen in the preview until this is updated.
